problems.quote: the distances from the mean are inversely proportional to the quantities
problems.problem: This property holds only for two components; for three or more components, distances from the mean are not simply inversely proportional to quantities.
problems.correction: the distances from the mean are inversely proportional to the quantities only for two components
problems.verifierReason: Alligation rule: inverse proportion of distances to quantities holds only for two components; original statement lacks this qualification.

problems.quote: the average rate of return over multiple periods with varying principal amounts is the weighted arithmetic mean of the period rates
problems.problem: For multiple periods with varying principal, the correct average is the internal rate of return (dollar-weighted) or time-weighted geometric mean, not the weighted arithmetic mean.
problems.correction: the average rate of return over multiple periods with varying principal amounts is the internal rate of return
problems.verifierReason: Weighted arithmetic mean is incorrect for multi-period returns with varying principal; internal rate of return (dollar-weighted) is the correct average.

problems.quote: Articles 239B‑239E empower the President to make regulations for the peace, progress and good government of UTs without legislatures.
problems.problem: Wrong article numbers; the President's power to make regulations for UTs without legislatures is under Article 240, not Articles 239B‑239E.
problems.correction: Article 240 empowers the President to make regulations for the peace, progress and good government of UTs without legislatures.
problems.verifierReason: Article 240, not 239B-239E, grants President regulation-making power for UTs without legislatures.

problems.quote: The Supreme Court in K. S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017) recognised that effective decentralisation is integral to the federal structure.
problems.problem: K.S. Puttaswamy (2017) is the right to privacy judgment; it did not deal with decentralisation or federal structure.
problems.correction: The Supreme Court has recognised that effective decentralisation is integral to the federal structure.
problems.verifierReason: Puttaswamy (2017) is privacy judgment; decentralisation-federalism link recognised in other cases (e.g., Krishnamurthy).
